loops.name: Angular rate 1 kHz and attitude 250 Hz (FC)
loops.path: IMU → `imu_frontend` → `imu_fusion` → attitude loop → rate loop → mixer → ESC → body motion → IMU

loops.name: Thermal imaging
loops.status: Estimation chain only, no actuator. `ros2_dashboard_node` (Vision → Thermal tab) only displays it

loops.name: Camera arm gaze
loops.path: 2 × IMX477 → `panorama_node` → detector → `object_detections` → `arm_look_at_node` → `/camera_arm/look_at` → `camera_arm_node` (IK, SIMC PI on the detection offset) → PCA9685 servos → camera moves → detection moves; MPU-6050 → horizon hold
loops.status: Closed on the image and on the plate IMU

loops.name: Stereo depth
loops.path: 2× IMX219 (worker) → `stereo_node`: rectification → SGM → spatial filter → per-pixel Kalman → Z, σ_Z
loops.status: Estimation chain only. The Stereo tab of `ros2_dashboard_node` displays it, calls services and writes parameters; every action is confirmed by the node's response and a read-back

loops.name: Target following
loops.path: `isaac_ros_target_follower_node` → `/cmd_vel` (heading frame) → `flight_controller_node` (`MANUAL` mode, `manual.source: cmd_vel`, `v_w = R_z(ψ̂) v_h`) → loop 4
loops.status: Closed on the UAV when the follower reads `odom_topic:=/odometry/filtered`. On the Jetbot, the base driver (subscribes `/cmd_vel`, publishes `/odom`) is outside the three repositories

loops.name: RF defence
loops.status: Closed through the FCN. Commands are latched, escalate-only, cleared with `~/reset`

loops.name: RF / GNSS link security (JetOwl)
loops.path: `jetowl_fc` → `/jetowl/security/{rf_link,gnss}` → `link_security` (detection only) → `/jetowl/security/threat` → `flight_controller_node` (GNSS attack → `LAND`, command link jammed and lost → `RTH`) → `/jetowl/security/response` → `uav_state_estimator` (stops fusing a distrusted receiver) → `/jetowl/security/advice` → `jetowl_fc` (`/gps/fix` NO_FIX for that receiver) → next epochs measured again
loops.status: Closed. The FC only lowers GNSS trust; every flight decision stays on the Jetson (JetOwl_FlightControl `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` §9, `docs/SECURITY.md`)

loops.name: Remote_UAV RTH button and missions
loops.path: remote → LoRa → `jetowl_fc` → `/jetowl/status` `rc_rth_request` → `jetowl_bridge` → `flight/nav_command RTH` (switch AUTO only); `/jetowl/mission/geo` → `geo_mission_node` → `mission/upload_waypoints` → `mission_planner_node` → `flight_controller_node` → loop 4, progress back on `/jetowl/mission/progress` → remote
loops.status: Closed through loop 4; the pilot's switch decides whether the Jetson flies (JetOwl_FlightControl `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` §9)

loops.name: Photo downlink (data, not control)
loops.path: `jetowl_fc` → `/jetowl/camera/request` → `snapshot_node` → `/jetowl/camera/jpeg` → `jetowl_fc` → 2.4 GHz image slot → remote; `/jetowl/camera/fc_status` (bitmap of chunks held) → `snapshot_node` resends the missing ones

loops.name: GNSS-free navigation and return to home
loops.status: Closed. With GNSS distrusted, the camera + LPB40B velocity keeps the ENU estimate (and home) valid; a GNSS attack or lost fix with healthy navigation → RTH along the flown path, σ_h above its bound → LAND (`ros2_gnss_denied_nav` README)

loops.name: Relative altitude
loops.status: Closed. Previously there was no barometer source
